title_en: Hangzhou Xiangsheng Textile Co., Ltd. v. Yuyao Shengkai Hardware Factory (General Partnership) — dispute over liability for damage caused by negotiable instruments
ruling_gist_en: After a negotiable instrument has been subject to a public notice for assertion of claims procedure and a people's court has rendered a judgment of nullity, the original lawful holder may file a lawsuit with the people's court on the ground that the applicant for the public notice improperly applied for such public notice, thereby causing the loss of the holder's rights on the instrument, and request the improper applicant for the public notice to bear liability for damages.

Hangzhou Xiangsheng Textile Co., Ltd. v. Yuyao Shengkai Hardware Factory (General Partnership) — dispute over liability for damage to negotiable instruments

Ruling Summary

After a negotiable instrument has been declared null and void by a people's court through the public summons for exhortation procedure, the original lawful holder may file a lawsuit with the people's court against the person who improperly applied for the public summons for exhortation, claiming damages, on the ground that such improper application caused the loss of the holder's rights under the negotiable instrument.

Plaintiff: Hangzhou Xiangsheng Textile Co., Ltd., domiciled at Xinyuan Village (within the Industrial Park), Dangshan Town, Xiaoshan District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province.
Legal Representative: Shen Baixiang, Chairman of the Board.

Defendant: Yuyao Shengkai Hardware Factory (General Partnership), domiciled at Yongfeng Village, Fengshan Subdistrict, Yuyao City, Zhejiang Province.
Representative: Zheng Wujun, Factory Director.

The plaintiff, Hangzhou Xiangsheng Textile Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Xiangsheng Company), filed a lawsuit with the Yuyao People's Court of Zhejiang Province regarding a dispute over liability for damage to negotiable instruments against the defendant, Yuyao Shengkai Hardware Factory (General Partnership) (hereinafter referred to as Shengkai Hardware Factory).

Plaintiff's Allegations: The plaintiff had a contractual sales relationship with Zhejiang Hengyuan Chemical Fiber Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Hengyuan Company). In October 2012, Hengyuan Company paid the plaintiff for goods with a bank acceptance draft with a face value of RMB 200,000 and number 40200051/22971609. The draft recorded: Drawer: Yuyao Biaohua Electric Appliance Co., Ltd.; Payee: Hubei Biaohua Electric Appliance Technology Co., Ltd.; Drawee bank: Business Department of Ningbo Yuyao Rural Cooperative Bank. The draft in question was endorsed and transferred multiple times. Later, when Shaanxi Sanyi Engineering Equipment Co., Ltd. sought payment, the drawee bank informed it that the instrument had been declared null and void by a judgment of the Yuyao People's Court, i.e., (2013) Yong Yu Cui Zi No. 4, rendered on March 19, 2013, and that the defendant, Shengkai Hardware Factory, had received the proceeds of the draft. Subsequently, the subsequent holders of the draft returned it in order to the plaintiff. The plaintiff contended that, as the lawful holder of the instrument and given that the defendant applied for public summons for exhortation on the ground of loss of the instrument, resulting in the nullity judgment which prevented the holder from realizing its rights under the instrument, the defendant should bear liability for compensation. Therefore, the plaintiff requested the court to order the defendant to pay RMB 200,000 as compensation for the loss of the acceptance draft, plus interest calculated from March 21, 2013, to the date determined by the judgment, at the benchmark interest rate for loans of the same type and same period issued by the People's Bank of China.

To support its claims, the plaintiff submitted the following evidence to the court: (1) Three delivery notes for goods sold by the plaintiff to the third party Hengyuan Company; one VAT invoice and one receipt issued by the plaintiff to the third party Hengyuan Company; a certificate of transfer of the instrument issued by Hengyuan Company; and a declaration issued by Hangzhou Fengheng Plastic Products Co., Ltd., to prove that the plaintiff lawfully obtained the draft in question; (2) A copy of the acceptance draft, to prove that the endorsements on the bank acceptance draft were consecutive and that the plaintiff was its lawful holder; (3) The judgment of the Yuyao People's Court of Zhejiang Province, (2013) Yong Yu Cui Zi No. 4, to prove that the instrument was declared invalid upon the application of the defendant, Shengkai Hardware Factory, thereby infringing the plaintiff's rights; (4) A receipt issued by Hangzhou Fengheng Plastic Products Co., Ltd., to prove that the plaintiff paid RMB 200,000 to its subsequent holder, Hangzhou Fengheng Plastic Products Co., Ltd., and consequently suffered a loss.

Defendant's Defense: The plaintiff, Xiangsheng Company, was not a lawful holder of the instrument, and the plaintiff's lawsuit against the defendant constituted malicious litigation. The defendant applied for public summons for exhortation because it had lost the instrument. During the period of public summons, no one claimed rights, and the defendant obtained the nullity judgment. The defendant was the lawful holder of the instrument and requested the dismissal of the plaintiff's claims.

To support its position, the defendant submitted the following evidence to the court: (1) Four copies of acceptance drafts and one electronic receipt (all photocopies), to prove that the defendant received four acceptance drafts in a single transaction from Yuyao Tai'an Electric Appliance Store and that the defendant was the lawful holder; (2) One civil ruling and one civil complaint from the Yuyao People's Court of Zhejiang Province, (2014) Yong Yu Shang Chu Zi No. 936, and one bank acceptance draft, to prove that Hangzhou Fengheng Plastic Products Co., Ltd. considered itself the lawful holder of the instrument in question; on its face, the final holder should have been Shaanxi Sanyi Engineering Equipment Co., Ltd.; the plaintiff, Xiangsheng Company, allegedly obtained the draft only after September 17, 2014, and the draft was still being transferred unlawfully after its maturity date, indicating that the plaintiff's lawsuit against the defendant was malicious.

Upon the application of the plaintiff, Xiangsheng Company, the Yuyao People's Court of Zhejiang Province lawfully retrieved the case file of (2013) Yong Yu Cui Zi No. 4.

Facts Found by the Court:

The plaintiff, Xiangsheng Company, had a contractual sales relationship with the third party Hengyuan Company. On October 8, 2012, Hengyuan Company paid the plaintiff for goods with a bank acceptance draft with a face value of RMB 200,000 and number 40200051/22971609. The draft recorded: Drawer: Yuyao Biaohua Electric Appliance Co., Ltd.; Payee: Hubei Biaohua Electric Appliance Technology Co., Ltd.; Drawee bank: Business Department of Ningbo Yuyao Rural Cooperative Bank; Amount: RMB 200,000; Date of issue: September 20, 2012; Maturity date: March 20, 2013. The endorsers recorded on the back of the draft were, in order: Shaoxing County Siqiao Textile Co., Ltd., Shaoxing County Binchi Textiles Co., Ltd., Hangzhou Aoxing Fangsu Co., Ltd., Zhejiang Hengyuan Chemical Fiber Group Co., Ltd., Hangzhou Xiangsheng Textile Co., Ltd., Hangzhou Bolier Chemical Co., Ltd., Jiangsu Huachang Chemical Co., Ltd., Zhangjiagang Free Trade Zone Huikang International Trade Co., Ltd., Hejin Longmen Carbon Black Co., Ltd., and Shaanxi Sanyi Engineering Equipment Co., Ltd. None of the above endorsements recorded any date. On January 11, 2013, the court accepted Shengkai Hardware Factory's application for public summons for exhortation on the ground of loss of the draft, and on March 19, 2013, rendered the nullity judgment (2013) Yong Yu Cui Zi No. 4, with the judgment announcement issued on the same day. Later, when Shaanxi Sanyi Engineering Equipment Co., Ltd., through the Xianyang Sub-branch of China Merchants Bank Co., Ltd., sought payment, the drawee bank informed it that the instrument had been declared null and void by the Yuyao People's Court of Zhejiang Province and that the defendant, Shengkai Hardware Factory, as the applicant for public summons for exhortation, had received the proceeds of the draft. [Shaanxi Sanyi Engineering Equipment Co., Ltd.] then returned the draft to its prior endorser, who in turn returned it to its own prior endorser, and so on, until it was returned to the plaintiff.

Opinion of the Court:

First, for a negotiable instrument transferred by endorsement, the endorsements must be consecutive; the holder proves its rights under the instrument through the consecutive endorsements. In this case, the bank acceptance draft provided by the plaintiff, Xiangsheng Company, had consecutive endorsements and could prove that the plaintiff lawfully obtained the draft from its prior endorser. Moreover, because the subsequent holders of the draft returned it in order to the plaintiff on the ground that the instrument had been declared null and void by a judgment and the bank refused payment, the plaintiff was the final lawful holder of the draft.

Second, a nullity judgment is rendered through the public summons for exhortation procedure. When an interested party or the true rights holder files a lawsuit on the negotiable instrument, their rights and obligations should not be bound by the nullity judgment. The draft in question did not record the dates of endorsements. In the absence of contrary evidence from the defendant, Shengkai Hardware Factory, the date on which the plaintiff, Xiangsheng Company, obtained the draft could be determined as the date on which it issued a receipt to Hengyuan Company, i.e., October 8, 2012. The plaintiff obtained the instrument before the public summons for exhortation and was a lawful holder. The defendant, Shengkai Hardware Factory, did not affix its seal in the endorsement column of the draft in question, did not provide effective evidence to the court proving that it lawfully obtained the instrument, and did not submit to the court any evidence regarding the loss of the instrument. In contrast, the draft in dispute submitted by the plaintiff contained all essential particulars, had consecutive endorsements, and was lawfully held by the plaintiff before the period of public summons for exhortation. Therefore, in the absence of contrary evidence proving that the plaintiff obtained the instrument with malice or gross negligence, the plaintiff should be deemed to have rights under the instrument. Accordingly, the court did not accept the defendant's defense that it was the final lawful holder of the instrument. The defendant was not the final lawful holder of the instrument but nevertheless obtained the proceeds of the draft by virtue of the nullity judgment, objectively causing loss to the plaintiff. The plaintiff, as the final lawful holder, is entitled to compensation for that loss. Therefore, the plaintiff's claim for compensation of RMB 200,000 for the loss of the acceptance draft was reasonable and lawful, and the court supported it. Regarding the plaintiff's claim for interest, because the plaintiff failed to provide effective evidence proving when its subsequent holders returned the draft to it and made payment, interest should be calculated from the date of filing of the lawsuit. The defendant's defenses lacked legal basis and were not accepted.

In conclusion, in accordance with Article 106 and Article 134, paragraph 1, item (7) of the *General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China*, and Article 31, paragraph 1 and Article 106 of the *Negotiable Instruments Law of the People's Republic of China*, the Yuyao People's Court of Zhejiang Province rendered the following judgment on March 9, 2015:

1. The defendant, Yuyao Shengkai Hardware Factory (General Partnership), shall pay the plaintiff, Hangzhou Xiangsheng Textile Co., Ltd., compensation for the loss of the acceptance draft (draft number: 40200051/22971609) in the amount of RMB 200,000, plus interest calculated from November 24, 2014, to the date determined by the judgment, at the benchmark interest rate for loans of the same type and same period issued by the People's Bank of China.

2. The remaining claims of the plaintiff, Hangzhou Xiangsheng Textile Co., Ltd., are dismissed.

The above payments shall be made within ten days from the date this judgment becomes legally effective. If the monetary payment obligation is not fulfilled within the specified period, interest on the debt for delayed performance shall be doubled in accordance with Article 253 of the *Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China* and relevant judicial interpretations.

Court acceptance fee in the amount of RMB 4,300, reduced by half to RMB 2,150, shall be borne by the defendant, Yuyao Shengkai Hardware Factory (General Partnership).

After the judgment of first instance, neither party appealed, and the judgment has become legally effective.
